base_commit_subject: feat: complete Phase 7 UI / Admin / MCP extension (#9)
scope: Phase 1-7 final evaluation evidence at main@6cdac54. This file is the single machine-readable source; docs/evaluation/evidence-registry.md is generated from it and validated for consistency.

status_definitions.REPRODUCIBLE_FINAL: Committed dataset + committed scorer/thresholds + committed final report; regenerating the numbers needs no paid model call and no external network (deterministic replay, or offline scoring of a frozen result set).
status_definitions.REPRODUCIBLE_PARTIAL: Frozen inputs, scorer and recorded result exist, but regenerating the exact numbers needs new paid model calls and/or a live runtime; only the scoring half is offline-reproducible.
status_definitions.HISTORICAL_ONLY: Retained consumed or superseded result; produced under a semantics/scorer that no longer reproduces it, or on a consumed holdout that must not be rerun.
status_definitions.NOT_COMPARABLE: A value exists but was produced with a different dataset, split, label set, scorer or metric definition, so it may not be compared with another phase's number.
status_definitions.NOT_RECORDED: No trustworthy committed evidence exists for this metric. It is not estimated, inferred or filled in.
status_definitions.REQUIRES_NEW_RUN: Obtainable only through a separately pre-registered and owner-authorized run (see the Gate 3 proposal).

label_methods.MODEL_REVIEWED: Labels proposed/reviewed by models; three independent model families for the frozen holdouts; never human gold.
label_methods.MODEL_SINGLE_FAMILY: Both annotation passes by one model family; weaker than three-model review.
label_methods.SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE: Dataset content is synthetic (fixture), even though it is frozen and model-reviewed.
